parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh: Chinese
*   en: English

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description: The query time. Unit: days. For example, if you set this parameter to 30, the governance rules within the last 30 days are queried.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse get-overview --period 1 --biz-region cn-hangzhou --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
